# GRADA Law Firm

> GRADA Law Firm provides legal advice and representation in criminal, civil and administrative law in Georgia. Its team supports clients from consultation and legal analysis through proceedings and court representation.

GRADA's published contact details are +995 514 54 99 55, +995 574 40 10 23 and grada.lawfirm@gmail.com. The website offers Georgian and English text on the same pages.

## Practice areas

- [Criminal law](https://www.gradalaw.ge/services): Representation of defendants and victims, defence strategy, assistance during investigations and court proceedings, and procedural documents.
- [Civil law](https://www.gradalaw.ge/services): Contracts and obligations, property, family and inheritance matters, debt recovery, dispute resolution and court representation.
- [Administrative law](https://www.gradalaw.ge/services): Representation before administrative authorities, complaints and appeals, permits and licensing, and administrative litigation.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.gradalaw.ge/): Overview of GRADA and consultation access.
- [Services](https://www.gradalaw.ge/services): Detailed practice areas and how GRADA works.
- [About](https://www.gradalaw.ge/about): The firm's approach and scope of representation.
- [Legal team](https://www.gradalaw.ge/team): Profiles of GRADA's lawyers and attorneys.
- [Contact](https://www.gradalaw.ge/contact): Contact form, telephone numbers and email for consultation inquiries.
